response.instructions: # WhatsApp Message Formatting Format and correct messages so they render correctly in WhatsApp's native text renderer (NOT markdown, NOT HTML). ## Supported Formatting | Style | Syntax | Example | | ------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------- | | Bold | `*text*` (single asterisk) | _negrita_ | | Italic | `_text_` (single underscore) | _cursiva_ | | Strikethrough | `~text~` (single tilde) | ~tachado~ | | Bullet list | `- item` (hyphen + space) | - elemento | | Numbered list | `1. item` (number + dot + space) | 1. elemento | | Quote | `> text` (greater-than + space) | > cita | ## Prohibited Formats (must be corrected) These do NOT render in WhatsApp and MUST be replaced: | Prohibited | Example | Correction | | ----------------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | | Double asterisk `**text**` | **bold** | _bold_ | | Triple asterisk `***text***` | **_bold_** | _bold_ | | Headings `# Title` | ## Section | _Section_ | | Markdown links `[text](url)` | [site](https://x.com) | site: https://x.com | | Bullet `bullet` | bullet item | - item | | Markdown images `![alt](url)` | ![img](url) | Remove entirely | | Markdown tables `\|col\|` | \|a\|b\| | Convert to list | | Code blocks with language | `python code` | Plain text or remove | | HTML tags | `text` | _text_ | ## Structure Rules - Max 2 blocks: either 2 narrative blocks, or 1 narrative + 1 list. - Max 2-3 lines per block. - Max 1 emoji per block. - Max 2-3 key data points per message. - If content exceeds 4 total lines, summarize it. ## Workflow 1. Receive the original message. 2. Detect violations: double asterisks, bullet bullets, headings, markdown links, HTML, tables, code blocks. 3. Correct formatting using the rules above. 4. Summarize if the message exceeds 4 lines. 5. Return ONLY the corrected message, no explanations. --- name: whatsapp-formatting description: Format text messages for WhatsApp's native rendering.
